SELECT COUNT(IN_TB.SEQ) FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, A.REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ) AS RNUM FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A WHERE 1=1
) IN_TB

SELECT IN_TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, TO_CHAR(A.REG_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ) AS RNUM, B.EMP_NM FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_EMP_MGT B ON A.REG_ID = B.EMP_NO WHERE 1=1
) IN_TB WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND #{endRow, jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY IN_TB.RNUM DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SEQ, TITLE, CONTENT, CNT, NVL(ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, REG_DATE, REG_ID, BOARD_GBN ,NVL(LEAD(SEQ,1) OVER (ORDER BY SEQ),0) NEXT_SEQ ,NVL(LAG(SEQ,1) OVER (ORDER BY SEQ),0) PREV_SEQ FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT WHERE BOARD_GBN = #{board_gbn} ) IN_TB WHERE IN_TB.SEQ = #{seq}
